decisions.label: Audit download burden
decisions.title: Files are a useful unit for a file question.
decisions.result: The frozen inventory can describe retrieval burden and representation membership. It cannot certify independent observations.
decisions.next: Replay the frozen inventory. Rebuild the declared query if the archive changes.
decisions.ceiling: Metadata accounting only. Original action/capture groups are filename/order-conditioned, not physically validated.

excerpt.estimand: product retrieval burden, representation inventory, and source-to-product relationships
excerpt.admissible_unit: archive product, exposure identity, or byte count when explicitly named
excerpt.limiting_boundary: not a scientific image-content or independent-sample claim
excerpt.status_changer: No additional evidence is required for the frozen cohort; re-run if the archive changes.

decisions.label: Evaluate a new Sunset
decisions.title: A held-out file is not a held-out Sunset.
decisions.result: The plan supplies one scheduled Sunset event. It cannot supply an internal two-sided new-Sunset-event evaluation.
decisions.unit: A justified whole event, not sibling files
decisions.next: Obtain a second comparable event or a justified external dataset. Within-event prediction is a different, conditional task.
decisions.ceiling: Schedule entries do not certify statistical independence; geometry, target construction and deployment still need qualification.

excerpt.estimand: performance on a distinct future or external Sunset event
excerpt.limiting_boundary: the mission plan contains one Sunset event, yielding zero two-sided internal event allocations
excerpt.status_changer: Obtain a second comparable event or external dataset and keep whole events on opposite sides.

decisions.label: Estimate target prevalence
decisions.title: Recorded tags do not reveal the full image population.
decisions.result: Blank target fields remain unknown. Filtering them out changes the population; recorded navigation fields are not validated image-content labels.
decisions.unit: A declared population and accepted target concept
decisions.next: Separate predicting a recorded field from recognizing appearance or physical identity. Establish reference judgments and a probability audit before estimating label quality or prevalence.
decisions.ceiling: Completion width is not a confidence interval. A blank-only audit cannot validate recorded tags.

excerpt.estimand: target classification over a declared archive population
excerpt.admissible_unit: event-safe groups from a task-specific audited label population
excerpt.limiting_boundary: only 44.872% of cohort exposures are tagged; coverage is activity-structured and camera is predictive inside the curated subset
excerpt.status_changer: Audit or relabel a population that includes blanks, define deployment prevalence, and require camera-only plus event-aware controls.

decisions.label: Interpret a flash null or rate
decisions.title: A null is useful only at a demonstrated sensitivity.
decisions.result: The overlapping clip-native screen does not demonstrate exclusionary sensitivity. Human observation conditions also changed.
decisions.unit: Calibrated detection and brightness-conditioned effective area-time
decisions.next: Qualify sensitivity, coverage, timing and dependence before an exclusion or calibrated rate. Inspect the synthetic recovery limits and separate human-state anchors.
decisions.ceiling: No event photometry, calibrated human threshold, exact flash location or lunar impact flux is supported here.

statement.source_owner: JPL reply reporting the science/archive teams' confirmation
statement.scope: One identical-image pair confirmed by the steward, using the original filename and metadata. This is not independent NEF-byte equality, confirmation of the other 23 candidate pairs, a completed archive fix, a public-JPEG processing recipe or endorsement of our analysis.

audit_trail.qualification: Original grouping is source-order sensitive. The separate abstaining candidate is not adopted. This is one-action withholding, not physical identity or all-ambiguity robustness.

flash_findings.proposition: The public annotation contains five accepted events, eight witness marks, and three observers.
flash_findings.claim_ceiling: Credible event ledger, not calibrated sensitivity or independent detections.

flash_findings.proposition: The later 30 fps window covered the annotation's 01:04 background-photo epoch.
flash_findings.claim_ceiling: Metadata-time non-overlap only. The photo epoch is not ledger creation or an upper bound for all five accepted events; their event-level video coverage remains unestablished.

flash_findings.proposition: The absence of a screened pulse in the overlap clip excludes the shared crew report.
flash_findings.claim_ceiling: Contextual temporal overlap, not event exclusion.

flash_findings.proposition: Five accepted events support a conservative whole-Moon one-hour detected-count floor.
flash_findings.claim_ceiling: Detected-count floor under explicit assumptions, not calibrated flux.

flash_findings.proposition: The five events establish a calibrated brightness-threshold lunar impact flux.
flash_findings.claim_ceiling: Blocked until a recomputable measurement function is public.

flash_findings.proposition: The two marks around the 00:51 report are independent confirmations suitable for capture-recapture inference.
flash_findings.claim_ceiling: Separate witness marks are preserved, but independence is not assumed without a declared dependence model.

conditional.status: Separate one-original-action withholding; unadopted reconstruction and physical identity unresolved.
